feed.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Jaroslav Dlouhy has expressed his intention to support and join the BIP Editors team, aiming to increase the number of contributors involved in the project. He is seeking guidance on what specific details are required from him to finalize the authorization process for joining the team.
Previously, Jaroslav had offered to contribute to the initiative two years prior, demonstrating an ongoing interest and commitment to participating in the development efforts. His message reflects a proactive approach and a willingness to formalize his role within the group.
